text: My tenant in Guntur has not paid rent for eight months, about Rs 96,000 in total, and refuses to vacate even after a written notice.
A courier boy delivered an empty box instead of the mobile phone I ordered and paid Rs 18,999 for. The online platform refuses a refund.
My neighbour Prakash poured kerosene near my door last night and shouted that he would burn my house down. My family in Nellore is scared.
I lent my college friend Rs 2,00,000 by bank transfer for his sister's wedding with a signed promissory note. Two years later he denies taking it.
The private school in Warangal is not giving my son's transfer certificate unless I pay an extra Rs 30,000 donation that was never part of the fees.
My employer deducted PF from my salary for three years but never deposited it in my PF account.
An unknown person used my Aadhaar copy to open a mobile connection and is using it for fraud calls. Police from another state called me.
My elder brother has locked our late father's house in Kakinada and refuses to give me and my sister any share, though there is no will.
A private doctor in Rajahmundry prescribed medicine without examining my wife and her kidney got damaged. Another hospital confirmed the wrong medicine.
A stranger snatched my gold chain while I was walking near the bus stand in Tirupati yesterday evening.
My husband's relatives took away all my stridhan jewellery after marriage and refuse to give it back now that we live separately.
The travel agent in Hyderabad took Rs 1,50,000 for a Thailand package, gave fake hotel bookings and is not answering calls.
A man has been following me from my office to my home every day for two weeks and keeps calling from different numbers.
The electricity department disconnected my house supply without any notice even though all my bills are paid up to date.
My contractor took Rs 4,00,000 advance to build two rooms, did only the foundation and has stopped work for six months.
My sister-in-law did not like the saree I gifted her at Diwali and said so in front of everyone.
My son scored 85 percent but wanted 90 percent. The board evaluated the paper correctly and the marks match his answers.
A YouTuber reviewed my favourite phone brand negatively and gave his honest opinion. I feel he should be punished.
My friend chose to go on holiday with other friends instead of me this summer.
I paid for a yoga class, attended all sessions, and the class was exactly as advertised, but I did not lose weight as quickly as I hoped.
My Canadian colleague in Toronto was rude to another Canadian colleague at their Toronto office. None of us are in India.
My cousin bought a bigger car than mine and keeps showing it off at family functions.
I bet Rs 5,000 with my roommate on an IPL final and lost. I want to get my money back through court.
The restaurant in Vizag was crowded and I had to wait 20 minutes for a table, then the food was fine.
Which documents do I need to apply for a passport renewal?
My neighbour's dog barks once in the morning when the milkman comes. It is not aggressive and stops quickly.
I might start a business next year and I am afraid some partner might cheat me in future.
My teacher gave the class a lot of homework for the holidays, same for every student.
My favourite TV serial ended with a sad climax and I want the channel to change it.
My old school friend got married and changed her surname, so I could not find her on Facebook.
